Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000767" [decision]: As of 2025-09-30, the billing API will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch.  (about: billing API, feature-flags, new invoice flow)
- memory_id "1000697": On 2025-09-16, Oskar wrote the handover doc for Diego for the authentication gateway handover to Cinder.  (about: Cinder, Diego, Oskar, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000658" [decision]: Clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, decided at the Atlas standup on 2025-09-02.  (about: feature-flags, clients)
- memory_id "1000630" [decision]: As of 2025-08-07, certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead.  (about: certificate expiry)
- memory_id "1000587" [constraint]: Every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000554" [decision]: The Atlas team owns the billing API as of 2025-06-09, when ownership passed from the Ember team; the Boreal team was recorded by mistake and never held it.  (about: Atlas team, Boreal team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000541": Lena has the pager rotation for the Boreal team as of 2025-06-27, taking over from Marcus.  (about: Boreal team, Lena, Marcus)
- memory_id "1000533" [decision]: The notifier is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-11, when ownership passed from the Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000480": On 2025-06-09, Oskar wrote the handover doc for the billing API for Lena.  (about: Lena, billing API, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000462" [decision]: Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan.  (about: ledger service, reviewed query plan)
- memory_id "1000430": As of 2025-05-15, the pager for webhooks rings the Boreal team instead of the Ember team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000424": The webhook dispatcher is owned by the Boreal team as of 2025-05-15, when ownership moved from the Ember team.  (about: Boreal team, webhook dispatcher, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000420": On 2025-05-15, Oskar walked Lena through the webhook dispatcher runbook.  (about: Lena, webhook dispatcher, Oskar)
- memory_id "1000412": The Cinder team observed on 2025-05-14 that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher, cache change)
- memory_id "1000395": The Boreal team noticed on 2025-05-07 that the authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump and pinged the owners.  (about: Boreal team, authentication gateway, dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000334": The notifier's request volume halved after the client rollout.  (about: notifier, client rollout)
- memory_id "1000331" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher, change policy)
- memory_id "1000236": Boreal noticed the ledger service's memory growth and pinged the owners on 2025-02-21.  (about: Boreal team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000224" [decision]: As of 2025-02-21, the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff.  (about: notifier)
- memory_id "1000177" [decision]: The notifier consumers will commit offsets every five seconds.  (about: notifier)
Existing entity names: billing API, feature-flags, new invoice flow, Cinder, Diego, Oskar, authentication gateway, clients, certificate expiry, Atlas team, Boreal team, Ember team, Lena, Marcus, Dune team, notifier, ledger service, reviewed query plan, webhook dispatcher, cache change, dependency bump, client rollout, change policy
